newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Taiwanese foreign minister in Indonesia-sources.
newsitem.headline: Taiwanese foreign minister in Indonesia-sources.

text.p: Taiwanese Foreign Minister John Chang is in Indonesia for a one-day private visit and will meet Foreign Minister Ali Alatas later on Wednesday, sources at the foreign ministry said.

The sources said Chang arrived in Jakarta on Tuesday night and will leave on Wednesday. China routinely attacks any attempts by Taiwan, which it regards as a renegade province, to boost its diplomatic profile.
Indonesia and Taiwan do not have diplomatic relations but have strong business links.

Taiwanese President Lee Teng-hui made an unofficial visit to Jakarta in February 1994. China, which has diplomatic relations with Indonesia, was enraged by the visit and lodged an official protest with Jakarta.
